How these tables work

AAA = 8/9 EX; MAX− = 17/18 EX; 98% = 98/100 EX. Ranges are ordered by fitted difficulty. Each range contains at most 20 charts, ordered by total archived LR2IR play count, including repeated plays. A range with fewer than 20 eligible charts stays smaller; charts are never pulled across a boundary to fill it.

These are May 2026 popularity counts, not current counts or unique-player counts. Selection favors frequently played charts and does not correct practice bias. Unsupported target estimates are marked provisional. The models were fitted to the full eligible pool, before popularity selection.
